verdict.rationale: The product is itself a set of agent-readable SKILL.md instruction files. Users can paste one into any chat or drop the folders into .claude/skills/, so an agent can consume its documentation directly. However, there is no llms.txt, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint returned 404. missing for 10: an llms.txt file, agent-oriented docs about the product separate from the skill files, a working .md docs endpoint, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
